_README: === THE 7 LINKS BELOW ARE DUMMY PLACEHOLDERS - REPLACE THEM WITH YOUR OWN ===
_HOW_TO: 1. Replace each dummy 'url' with your own website link.
2. Keep {query} where the search word should go. Example: https://mysite.com/?s={query}  (if you leave {query} out, the scraper adds ?s=<searchword> for you).
3. 'type': 'image' for picture sites, 'gif' for GIF sites.
4. 'enabled': true to use a slot, false to switch it off without deleting it.
5. Save, restart the scraper, then open /my-links in the browser to check.
A dead slot never breaks a search - it is skipped and logged.
The built-in sites (darknaija, pornpics, reddit, imagefaqs, tenor, giphy ...) were NOT touched - your links are tried AFTER them.
